opener.title: How climate change affects California's water
opener.subtitle: Adapting to a hotter, more variable climate future
opener.p11: California’s water management systems are under strain
opener.p12: from the needs to provide safe and affordable drinking water, grow food,
opener.p13: and protect ecosystem and cultural water uses.
opener.p2: Climate change is making matters worse.
opener.p31: Climate change is bringing warmer temperatures,
opener.p32: more volatile precipitation patterns, and rising sea levels
opener.p33: that stress our water infrastructure and our living environment.
opener.throughline: How can we limit the impacts of climate change on California's water future?
